open_points.subject: A1: case-insensitive conflict marker matching
open_points.question: Which case-equivalence rule must be used when testing a path component for `.sync-conflict-`: ASCII-only folding, Unicode simple case mapping, or Unicode case folding?
options: Compare the ASCII letters of the marker case-insensitively
Apply Unicode case folding to the whole name
Apply Unicode normalization followed by case folding
open_points.default_guess: Compare the ASCII marker case-insensitively without Unicode normalization.

witness.initial: The photo folder contains a regular file named `trip.ſync-conflict-copy.jpg`, where the first character of `ſync` is U+017F LATIN SMALL LETTER LONG S.
events: The calling flow requests a scan.
The scanner tests the name for the conflict marker.
outcomes: Unicode case folding turns `ſ` into `s`, so the file is ignored.
ASCII-only case-insensitive comparison does not match the marker, so the file is reported.
witness.observer: The calling flow sees whether the file appears in the scan.

open_points.subject: A1: placement when an ordinary file and a conflict copy share a source hash
open_points.text: placing it by its hash fails with `not_ready_or_absent`
open_points.question: When the requested source hash belongs both to an eligible ordinary file and to an ignored conflict copy, must placement succeed for the ordinary file or fail because a conflict copy has that hash?
options: Succeed when at least one currently eligible ordinary file has the hash
Fail when any ignored conflict copy has the hash
open_points.default_guess: Succeed using the first eligible ordinary file; ignored files do not participate in placement lookup.

witness.initial: The folder contains `photo.jpg` and `photo.sync-conflict-device-20261118.jpg`; both are regular files with identical content and therefore the same source hash.
events: The calling flow scans the folder and receives `photo.jpg` but not the conflict copy.
The calling flow requests placement using the shared source hash.
outcomes: Placement succeeds because the reported ordinary file is eligible.
Placement fails with `not_ready_or_absent` because a conflict copy has the requested hash.
witness.observer: The calling flow sees either a placement or a refusal.

open_points.subject: A1: conflict-copy refusal versus M04 repeated placement
open_points.text:
`INV-18: a conflict copy, in the folder or a subfolder and in either letter case, is absent from the scan and placing it by its hash fails with `not_ready_or_absent` (`test_a_syncthing_conflict_copy_is_neither_offered_nor_placed`).`
`A repeated placement returns it and writes nothing (P-06).`
open_points.question: If the conflict copy's source hash already has a PhotoPlacement, does the placement call replay that placement or fail with `not_ready_or_absent`?
options: Return the existing PhotoPlacement without writing
Fail with `not_ready_or_absent` whenever the only current source file is a conflict copy
open_points.default_guess: Return the existing placement, because replay creates no placement from the conflict copy and preserves P-06.

witness.initial: Source content H was placed successfully, creating M04, and the ordinary source file was later replaced; a Syncthing conflict copy containing H is now the only file with that hash.
events: The calling flow requests placement of source hash H again.
outcomes: M04 and P-06 return the existing placement and write nothing.
INV-18's Required tests behavior refuses the call with `not_ready_or_absent`.
witness.observer: The calling flow sees either the existing placement or the refusal.

open_points.subject: A1: conflict marker policy value
open_points.text:
A name is ignored, in any letter case and at every level of the path, when it begins with a dot or
with `~syncthing~`, ends in `.tmp` or `~`, or contains `.sync-conflict-`, the mark of a Syncthing
conflict copy (R0-14).
open_points.rule:
У значения, которое читает генерируемый код, ровно три пути; путь
выбирается по тому, что это за значение, и у значения один дом (§15.4).
open_points.question: The conflict-marker policy must name one valid delivery path, normally an imported provider constant for the marker or the closed ignored-name policy.

open_points.subject: A1: conflict-copy refusal code
open_points.text: - INV-18: a conflict copy, in the folder or a subfolder and in either letter case, is absent from the scan and placing it by its hash fails with `not_ready_or_absent` (`test_a_syncthing_conflict_copy_is_neither_offered_nor_placed`). A real Syncthing conflict leaves its copy unreported while the photo itself is still reported (`e2e_local_syncthing.py`, `a real Syncthing conflict copy is not offered`).
open_points.rule: | закрытый список вариантов: статусы, виды, коды | `models`, перечисление | `= models.ИмяПеречисления` | перечисление как тип |
open_points.question: The refusal code must become a member of a models enumeration and be named by its member name together with the enumeration address.
